LESSON: EID

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: ISLAMIC
Topic 5.1: Eid

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Eid. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is Eid?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the importance of digital devices i.e. laptop, Eid activities by participating computer etc in the celebrations • Learners watch Eid

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: EID
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Eid helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: EID
Study Eid like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the importance of digital devices i.e. laptop, Eid activities by participating computer etc in the celebrations • Learners watch Eid

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the importance of digital devices i.e. laptop, Eid activities by participating computer etc in the celebrations • Learners watch Eid. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the importance of digital devices i.e. laptop, Eid activities by participating computer etc in the celebrations • Learners watch Eid.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Eid” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the importance of digital devices i.e. laptop, Eid activities by participating computer etc in the celebrations • Learners watch Eid. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Eid is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Eid” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the importance of digital devices i.e. laptop, Eid activities by participating computer etc in the celebrations • Learners watch Eid)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Eid to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of digital devices i.e. laptop, Eid activities by participating computer etc in the celebrations • Learners watch Eid.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Eid from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Eid: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Eid?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is Eid?
2. How do we celebrate Eid?
3. How did you celebrate Eid?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Eid means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the importance of digital devices i.e. laptop, Eid activities by participating computer etc in the celebrations • Learners watch Eid.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
